crew.overview: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a group of Jewish-American soldiers known as "The Basterds" are chosen specifically to spread fear throughout the Third Reich by scalping and brutally killing Nazis. The Basterds, lead by Lt. Aldo Raine soon cross paths with a French-Jewish teenage girl who runs a movie theater in Paris which is targeted by the soldiers.
crew.title: Inglourious Basterds

crew.overview: In the year 2035, convict James Cole reluctantly volunteers to be sent back in time to discover the origin of a deadly virus that wiped out nearly all of the earth's population and forced the survivors into underground communities. But when Cole is mistakenly sent to 1990 instead of 1996, he's arrested and locked up in a mental hospital. There he meets psychiatrist Dr. Kathryn Railly and the son of a famous virus expert who may hold the key to the Army of the 12 Monkeys; thought to be responsible for unleashing the killer disease.
crew.title: Twelve Monkeys

details.biography:
Lloyd Phillips, born in South Africa and raised in New Zealand, was a talented creative producer and physical line producer best known for Man of Steel (2013), Vertical Limit (2000) and Twelve Monkeys (1995) as well as winning the best live-action short film Oscar for The Dollar Bottom (1981).

He died from a heart attack in January 2013 in Los Angeles, California, USA three years before his wife, Beau St. Clair who was also a film producer, also passed away in January 2016.
details.name: Lloyd Phillips
